Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public. 




Mazdoor Kisan Shakti Sangathan 
"The Right to Information, The Right to Live"

Indian Standard 

SPECIFICATION FOR 

WOODEN STAVES USED FOR DRUM ROLLERS 

OF JUTE CARDING MACHINES 



1. Abbreviation — Different carding machines and drum rollers shall be as follows: 



- Name 
Breaker 
Finisher

2.1 Timber — The staves should be manufactured from well seasoned timber in accordance with 
IS : 1 141-1973 ' Code of practice for seasoning of timber ( first revision ) '. 

2.1.1 Freedom from defects —The wood of the staves shall be free from visible defects like bark pockets, 
knots, cracks, honeycombing, splits and gumducts which are likely to affect the life and perfection 
in pinning the staves. For the description of various types of defects [see IS : 707-1968 Glossary 
of terms applicable to timber and timber products ( first revision ) ]. 

3. Length — As specified in the contract subject to a tolerance of mm. 

4. Width — As specified in the contract. 

5. Thickness — Shall be as follows with respect to the type of the rollers subject to a tolerance 

£ +000 
of _ . 25 mm: 

Type of Roller 

C, Fd, Fs and W 
S and D 

6. Sampling 

6.1 Wooden staves of the same designation, made from the same species of timber and delivered 
against same despatch note shall constitute a lot. 

6.2 The acceptance of a lot shall be according to the column 3 of the following sampling table:

7. Designation — The designation for the staves of the feed roller ( Fd ) of 470 mm diameter over 
wood of a breaker ( B ) having cylinder ( C ) of 1 220 mm diameter over wood shall be as under: 

Example: 

Fd470. BC1220 

8. Marking — Each stave shall be marked at the back with its designation. ( See example in 7 ). 

8.1 ISI Certification Marking — Details available with the Indian Standards Institution, New 
Delhi 110001. 

9. Packing — As specified in the contract.

'4 J The four upright members shall be connected to the angle iron metal frame 
suitably so as to provide a rigid construction. The lop shall be of stainless steel 
sheet of 1 mm thick with a drainage tube as shown in Ftg. 1. The top of the table 
shall have sloping to facilitate the drainage into the drain hole.*
